game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the shadow ranger must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den
core_gameplay_loop: In Spider Den, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the alert value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about alert to power up the shadow ranger and open the stone seal.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Spider Den'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Spider Den.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
